$comment: US consumer preorders, read by app/lib/us-sales.ts. The US is sold direct only while the PUBLIC_US_SALES gate is "1" in the wrangler config AND rate is a number: the flat US shipping rate in USD that the Shopify US shipping zone charges. null keeps the US closed even with the gate on. Every product sells to the US: a campaign SKU from its first US-serving batch, any other SKU as a preorder of `usStock` in preorders.json. Only Belgian paid stock (batch `regions` in preorders.json) is EU only. priceUpliftPct is the percentage on top of the EUR VAT-inclusive price for a US buyer: Shopify's US price list adds it, converts to USD at its FX rate and rounds to whole dollars. It covers US duties and import handling; no US sales tax is collected. Shopify holds the live value; `npm run us:prices` compares it with this file and, with --apply, writes this file's value to the price list. Changing the number is a pricing decision that needs the founder's go.
